vaultGraphSurface.title: Vault Graph
vaultGraphSurface.resetColorsHint: Drop every override and go back to the automatic order
vaultGraphSurface.paletteHint:
Twelve slots, handed out in folder order and round again. Setting
        one folder never moves another, and two folders may share a colour.
vaultGraphSurface.refreshHint: Back to the defaults, and replay the intro. Clears highlights and the date range, and returns each folder to the visibility set in the gear -- so archives go back to hidden. This page is a snapshot -- its data was baked in when it was built -- so to pick up notes written since, rebuild it with refresh-graph.ps1 (or build-graph.mjs). The Obsidian plugin rebuilds in place instead.
vaultGraphSurface.debugHint: Copy the exact layout state, for a bug report
vaultGraphSurface.fitHint: Fit the disc (or double-click the graph)
vaultGraphSurface.panHint: Drag to pan. Off pins the disc to the centre.
vaultGraphSurface.rebuildHint: Rebuild from the vault and replay. Picks up notes written since the graph was drawn, and clears every filter.
vaultGraphSurface.autoHint: Back to the slot this folder gets automatically
vaultGraphSurface.unresolved: {count} link(s) point at notes that do not exist
vaultGraphSurface.markHint: click to mark them on the disc
